discord._follow: Discord members to follow, by priority (id, username or display name): the bot joins their voice channel and follows them when they move. Nobody in voice: voiceChannelId.

_target: 'our-team': only players of the team with at least one name from nicknames. 'everyone': both teams. Can be changed while the bot is running.
_nicknames: In-game name -> spoken nicknames, one drawn at random for each line. Case, accents, spaces and punctuation don't matter, and a name cut short by the game (8 characters or more) is recognized: MonSuperPseudo2000 = MonSuperPséudo20. These names also define our team. Unknown names are read as is. Can be changed while the bot is running.
_pronunciation: Words replaced right before the voice, so that it says them correctly. Can be changed while the bot is running.
_voice: rotation: 'random' (never the same twice in a row), 'alternate' (each in turn) or 'fixed' (always the first). jingle: true (ding before each line), false, or the path of your own sound (e.g. sounds/whistle.mp3). Can be changed while the bot is running, except the volume.
_pregenerate: Prepares in advance (in the background) the lines that only mention the squad, so they play without waiting for the voice.
_recordMatches: Records every match in matches/ (replayable with --replay), with the bot's comments in it.
_thresholds: Detection thresholds (see REGLES.md). Distances in game units (100 = 1 m), speeds in km/h, durations in ms. Can be changed while the bot is running; npm run calibrate suggests values from your votes.
_rocketLeague: checkApi: at launch then every 10 min, sets PacketSendRate back to the right value in DefaultStatsAPI.ini (Steam and Epic found automatically; gamePaths to add an install folder by hand).
